kind: Diagnostic replay of stored recovery comparison memories; not new training or independent biological validation
calibration: Simultaneously stimulate existing, annotated LC4 and LPLC2 cells that directly input to either GF. Experimental positive-control input, not natural looming.
decoder: Per cell normalize (cue - resting)/(LC4/LPLC2 panel - resting). Danger is max of the two un-clipped normalized GF responses; prefer lower danger, exact ties choose A. No learned head or outcome enters the decoder.
choice: Un-clipped diagnostic signal avoids hiding small effects. This differs from proposed clipped application readout and is not a validated action interface.
effects: Acquisition: change in punished-minus-safe danger margin from naive memory. Reversal: change in newly punished-minus-newly safe margin from acquisition. Report all conditions and seeds without fitting gain, polarity or thresholds.
causality: Reconstruct naive, saved acquisition and saved reversal memory; re-probe reset and restored memory exactly. No memory.observe, gradients, optimizer, new wiring or plastic updates.
interpretation: A positive causal GF effect can motivate a new frozen choice experiment; wrong choices or direction count against this candidate. Reused training seeds and post hoc diagnostic readout cannot establish held-out transfer or pass Gate B.
